objects.purpose: Partition an integer pixel grid into same-color connected objects
objects.contract: grid: rectangular integer matrix up to 64x64; optional background and connectivity

plan.purpose: Plan dependency layers and distinguish cyclic tasks from blocked descendants
plan.contract: tasks: mapping of names to dependency-name lists; at most 128 tasks

probe.purpose: Choose the experiment with minimum expected surviving hypotheses
probe.contract: candidates: 1..128 equally long prediction vectors of 1..128 categorical strings; uniform prior

scene.purpose: Compose perception with an assembly dependency plan
scene.contract: objects input; outputs object summaries and a dependency schedule
